title: Blueberry — live Monad Yearn-V3 vaults + Ethereum/HyperEVM remnants: unprivileged extraction = $0

Strategy contracts (CurvanceOptimizer, Yearn TokenizedStrategy) are closed to public deposits (open=false; only the Blueberry vault whitelisted) and report()/tend() are onlyKeepers
Strategy shares are 100% held by the Blueberry vaults (balanceOf(vault) == totalSupply)
Vault/strategy accounting is stored (total_idle+total_debt); direct token donations do not move pricePerShare (fork-proven), so no inflation/donation attack
deposit->redeem and mint->withdraw round-trips cannot profit (2-3 wei rounding loss, fork-proven)
kickAuction reverts on the protected asset/markets; claim() proceeds accrue to the strategy
ETH BlueberryBank positions 38/39 are over-collateralised (risk 0) -> liquidate reverts; bank status 15
ETH compound-fork markets have ~zero borrows (only the bank's 36.32 USDC + 0.015 WETH) -> no liquidatable accounts
HyperEVM router redeem is permissionless but escrow USDC liquidity is only $498 of $10,300 TVL; L1->EVM withdrawal is onlyRole(LIQUIDITY_ADMIN)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract only ~$0.84 live from Blueberry (a cWMON reward-dust auction discount); the ~$1.24M of real value is either holder-redeemable (Monad Yearn-V3 vaults ~$1.204M, ETH compound fork ~$26k, bank positions $79, HL ~$498) or privileged-only (HL router ~$9.8k), because all admin/reporting/debt paths are role-gated, strategies are closed and keeper-only, and stored accounting blocks donation/inflation attacks.
